title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
summary: A young scientist brings a living being to life from stolen parts, then abandons it in horror. The creature, shaped by loneliness and rejection, begins to pursue its maker.
readIf: you like gothic tales that ask who the real monster is, and want the original rather than the film.
skipIf: you want a pacy horror story, because the novel is reflective, wordy and full of long speeches.

pairings.reason: Another short Victorian tale of a scientist whose experiment turns on him.
A quieter modern story that asks what we owe to beings that people have made for their own use.
A more modern gothic with body horror and a strong sense of decaying family secrets.
